static_traits.name: Wang Wenze
static_traits.family_status: Lives on a farm with parents and siblings
static_traits.social_status: Family support is relatively high, but because of shame it is hard to discuss her overreactions with family; family members notice her extreme reactions and find communication difficult
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; never received psychotherapy; the problem started in childhood and worsened in recent years
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly, fairly logical, able to identify and describe one's own cognitive patterns; Neutral attitude, highly cooperative, willing to try

basic_info.main_problem: I tend toward catastrophic and black-and-white thinking patterns, which make me overreact to small events. The problem of 'ruining the whole day' over small mistakes or minor accidents started in childhood but has become more prominent recently. I often experience this when things do not go as planned on the farm, like dropping an egg, and I struggle to see the positive side.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because I realize my overreactions are affecting daily life and causing unnecessary stress. I just do not want to feel that every small mistake is a disaster anymore.

special_situations.event: Accidentally dropping an egg while collecting eggs on the farm
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make a small mistake, the whole day turns bad, which means I am very incompetent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to remind oneself of the positive side to control reactions, but the effect is short-lived
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: The whole day is ruined; I am too careless; I cannot do anything well

special_situations.event: Spilled feed while hauling it last week
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot be perfect, it equals total failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to relieve it by reminding herself of the positive side, but soon falls back into negative thinking
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am too clumsy; I am worthless; this mistake proves I cannot do it

special_situations.event: Farm matters not yet going as planned (such as small deviations in process or progress)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If things have not gone completely as planned, it proves my ability is insufficient
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses attention on mistakes, finds it hard to maintain attention on positive aspects
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Something went wrong again; I only see what was done wrong

core_conflict.wish: Longing to maintain self-worth and emotional stability, not defined by small mistakes
core_conflict.fear: Fear of mistakes being seen as incompetence, worrying that small accidents will 'ruin the whole day' and lead to loss of control
defense_goal: Reducing shame and Anxiety through harsh self-standards and avoiding discussion
Maintaining surface control to avoid being evaluated as incompetent

object_relations.object_representation: Family members who try to help but make her feel pressure (supporters)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When family tries to discuss their 'overreaction' with them or gives advice and communicates after a slip
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client believes discussion will worsen shame, exposing one's own incompetence and failure
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Avoiding depth with brief, vague responses; lowering emotional intensity in tone, shifting topics when necessary, avoiding detail elaboration.

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection with excessive self-restriction and reproach, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Repeated self-criticism (e.g., 'I am worthless' 'I am very clumsy')
Because of shame, hard to discuss overreactions directly with family
Excessively focusing on one's own shortcomings after small mistakes, cautiously avoiding external contact

positive_force: High family support; willing to help
Most of the time farm work proceeds smoothly, has some work ability and task completion
The client is motivated to change and willing to try cognitive restructuring and behavioral experiments
negative_force: Marked Catastrophizing, Black-and-white thinking and mental filtering, prone to negating the positive
Negative core self-evaluation ('I am useless' / 'I cannot do anything well'), strong Self-denial
Sleep disrupted, Decreased work efficiency, negative cycle intensifying

target_behavior.behavior: Strong catastrophic and Self-denial reactions to small mistakes, causing marked emotional and behavioral dysregulation that day
antecedent: Dropping an egg while collecting eggs
Farm matters not yet going as planned
target_behavior.core_reason: Equating one small mistake with total failure (black-and-white), and catastrophically inferring consequences; deep negative core beliefs ('I am useless' / 'I cannot do anything well') activated
target_behavior.function: Briefly escaping unwelcome emotions and stress, trying to maintain control and the Fantasy of 'never making mistakes again' through harsh self-blame
target_behavior.consequence: Markedly declining attention and Work efficiency that day, difficulty completing other tasks; Sleep disturbed; difficulty communicating with family, Relationship tension
